name: M3_PPS200MI_LstReceiptsByPO
description: List goods receipt transactions for a purchase order and display the main receipt details per purchase order line. Each record represents one reported goods receipt for a specific purchase order line and subline. The output includes purchase order identification and status, receiving number, warehouse and ship‑to warehouse, stock location, lot and container, transaction date and time, reported quantities in basic and alternate units, supplier, agreement number, and the responsible user. Use this read‑only operation to review how and where a purchase order has been physically received into stock.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number identifying which order’s goods receipt transactions to list.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number used to filter receipts for a specific line.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix used to filter receipts for a specific split of the line.

outputParameters.name: PNLX
outputParameters.description: Additional line suffix identifying the specific goods receipt transaction line.

outputParameters.name: PUOS
outputParameters.description: Status of the purchase order transaction corresponding to this goods receipt.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number uniquely identifying the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: STWH
outputParameters.description: Ship-to warehouse that ultimately receives the goods from this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Warehouse location where the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number of the received goods.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container on which the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the goods receipt transaction was reported.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when the goods receipt transaction was reported.

outputParameters.name: RPQT
outputParameters.description: Reported quantity for this goods receipt transaction in the transaction unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RPQA
outputParameters.description: Reported quantity for the receipt in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for this goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number under which this purchase transaction is placed, if applicable.
